domain.seed_sites: Exactly each movable ref original site and v1 site from sealed prior pose epoch
domain.claim_boundary: Finite orthogonal local repair domain, not continuous-placement or global infeasibility. No domain expansion or repeat execution in this epoch.

copper_policy.zones: preserved definitions; refill and native original groups NOT RUN
copper_policy.final_screen: If a candidate exists, recheck it against ALL original copper and distinguish replay contacts/conflicts from preserved-object conflicts.

group_policy.sensitive_refs: Complete24 closure retained; all source pin/net/UUID identities and fixed panel/harness/circuit constraints unchanged
group_policy.bypass_distance_bound: Each bypass center stays no farther from its assigned IC center than in the original source; source-derived repair policy, not new owner constraint

candidate_selection: Deterministic one joint assignment after domain screening; prefer short C2312.1/U2312.12 distance to fixed U2306.5 and small other displacements. No route searches.

failure_policy: Retain every evaluated pose first-refusal witness and empty-domain/joint-cap proof. No widening neighboring groups or second search.
continuity_policy: Every reconstruction obligation must retain all original segment endpoint ports or via layer/drill ports and reconnect all source-contact pad UUIDs at their selected candidate poses, preserving full original connected groups. Enumerate retained same-net adjacent objects. No geometric screen or unchanged source-file hash proves that reconstruction or connectivity is complete. All same-net physical contacts along each complete reconstructed segment, including mid-segment T/overlap contacts, must be enumerated. Preserve via diameter/drill/layers in contact records.

hole_policy.via_to_SMD: Preserve exact_access via/SMD annulus nonoverlap for all existing through vias regardless of net; 0.000001mm positive margin
hole_policy.other_fixed_drills: Retain original dump circular drill envelope plus0.25mm copper clearance, regardless of net; source conservative placement screen
hole_policy.source_only_limit: Native slot/drill/full-warning checks remain NOT RUN; no replacement for native acceptance
